problem: The native team screen could disappear while the new startup context had no snapshot or an older team_setup snapshot, exposing the game HUD before admission.
behavior: GameSetup uses its own explicitly tagged startup layout and leaves Valve team selection and Start controls available.
HeroSelection, PregameStrategy and Hud start with an opaque, input-blocking startup surface before the first script render.
Missing or stale team_setup snapshots never uncover the game in those later contexts.
Only the authoritative admission decision releases the cover; all_ready cannot override an explicit false admission_complete.
Completed-session memo, genuine image handshake, errors, retries, player identity checks and hidden-idle watchdog remain intact.
No native client GameRules or player-info queries were added.
limitation: Native compilation and production-script regression checks passed; a new multiplayer lobby transition was not manually exercised.
preserved: Existing map, material, generated-resource and local Python-cache changes are outside this scoped fix and remain in their respective working trees.
